articles.summary: Smithsonian Secretary Lonnie Bunch announced he will retire later this year following clashes with the White House. Driving the news: Bunch will step down by the end of the year after nearly 38 years at the Smithsonian, the institution said Tuesday. "It is time for my next chapter, a chapter that will allow me to continue to protect the integrity of the Smithsonian and to champion the importance of a history that illuminates and celebrates the complex story of our nation," the 73-year-old said.
